lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately three to four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible along the mid-lateral flank, showing a relatively uniform spatial distribution of local maxima posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the shark's flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper-lateral region, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and lower intensity shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized distribution of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary blobs found on the main lateral flank.
